sections.title: Verbs of Community Engagement and Their Cases
sections.content: Some verbs need a fixed ending. The new group takes *-ban/-ben*: *részt vesz valamiben* (to take part in something), *bízik valakiben* (to trust someone), *hisz valamiben* (to believe in something), *csalódik valamiben* (to be disappointed in something). You know the other groups: verbs with -hoz/-hez such as *csatlakozik* (to join; Unit 9) and *együttműködik* + -val/-vel (A2 Unit 5).

items.spanish: Meg részt vesz a közösségi programban.
items.english: Meg takes part in the community programme.
We believe in the strength of the community.
